visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with a short black bob haircut and a white knitted cardigan over a grey top sits in a brightly lit indoor space. She looks directly at the camera and speaks with a smiling expression, gesturing with her hands. Behind her is a white bookshelf containing various small objects and a white wall. (2) Close-up view of hands with red-orange nail polish holding a white square product box with black text and then a black circular cushion foundation case featuring a silver triangular Prada logo. The case has a textured nylon finish. (3) The cushion case is opened, revealing a mirror and a black sponge puff with a white strap. A hand peels off a beige circular protective seal from the product surface, exposing the foundation liquid beneath. (4) The woman applies the product by tapping the puff onto her right cheek and under-eye area. Multiple close-up shots show the blending process, her facial features, and the immediate change in her skin's appearance as yellow captions appear at the bottom. (5) Extreme close-ups show the woman's face focusing on specific areas like her eyes and chin. She points a finger at her under-eye circles and a small blemish on her chin to demonstrate the foundation's coverage. Her facial expressions are engaged and analytical. (6) A hand holds a smartphone displaying the time 1:37 on a lock screen with a dog image. Subsequent shots show her face from different angles under natural indoor light as she points at her cheeks and chin to show the product's wear after a period of time.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近很多人在討論一個產品. [Logo]: @HanHan. (2) [Subtitle]: 激起我的好奇心. (3) [Subtitle]: 於是我就購買了. (4) [Subtitle]: 原生霧光尼龍氣墊. [Slogan]: PRADA. (5) [Subtitle]: 最吸引我的之一. [Variety]: (標誌性 Re-Nylon 尼龍外殼). (6) [Subtitle]: 就是它漂亮的外包裝. (7) [Variety]: (取粉超均勻). (8) [Variety]: 妝感超服貼. (9) [Variety]: 壓一次即可上完全臉. [Subtitle]: (完妝只要 30 秒 懶人必備). (10) [Subtitle]: 原先以為遮瑕會超重超高. (11) [Subtitle]: 雖然有遮瑕 可是是屬於輕薄路線. (12) [Subtitle]: 粉體密度 會讓肌膚更緊緻. (13) [Subtitle]: 黑眼圈幾乎被遮光. (14) [Subtitle]: 8成的痘印被遮覆 但還是凸凸的. (15) [Subtitle]: 那是痘痘自己不爭氣. (16) [Subtitle]: 現在時間 1:37 我們就來看看. (17) [Subtitle]: 六個小時之後 它是不是還長得如此精緻. (18) [Subtitle]: 這是帶妝 7 小時之後 目前的妝感. (19) [Subtitle]: 從鼻翼兩頰到顴骨 都維持得很好. (20) [Subtitle]: 唯獨痘印的遮瑕 稍微掉了一點點. (21) [Subtitle]: 可是妝感還是很漂亮 是捨不得卸妝的那種.
